mapper.textPrompt:
Classify this email that a job candidate received from an employer or recruiting system.
Answer with exactly one of these labels and nothing else:
דחייה = the employer declines: not moving forward, chose other candidates, no match, position filled.
צעד הבא = the employer wants to continue: interview or call invite, asks for availability, home assignment or test, asks for more details, or an offer.
אישור קבלה = automatic acknowledgement that the application was received or is under review, no decision yet.
אחר = anything else.
